Dead code removed (orphaned sort branches, legacy scope-input listener), README dashboard sections updated. 5k sweep: DOMContentLoaded 55ms, every tab DOM ≤345 elements vs 10k records, graph overview 6 nodes, light+dark themes clean, 0 console errors. Regression on real .twining (554 records): all 7 tabs incl. untouched Search/Agents work. Suite 1173 green, build ok. PHASE 5 AND ALL 17 PLAN TASKS COMPLETE.
Decisions: Kept paginate/renderPagination/sortData/applyGlobalScope in app.js — still live for the legacy Agents/Search tabs; they retire when those tabs migrate (out of this plan's scope by design).; Deferred the Blackboard Stream view rework (still O(dataset) DOM) — flagged as a discovered need in Task 8; retiring or windowing it is a user-facing product call (the stream is a deliberate presentation mode), so it goes to the wrap-up report rather than being unilaterally deleted.
